implemented: Exactly one deterministically ordered record per registry entry, including entries without incoming memberships.
Identity is the exact registry key; locator uses RFC 6901 token escaping.
Metadata is the complete original entry without defaults, filtering, sorting arrays, renames, or document overlays.
Unknown nested fields, heterogeneous arrays, primitive types, explicit null, empty containers, and absent fields retain their authored distinctions.
Presentation title and description only use authored strings; nonstring source values remain unchanged in metadata.
Architecture documents never manufacture Component identities or overwrite registry type/status.
Absent optional registry yields an empty result; present malformed JSON, envelope, entries, identity conflicts, and detail_ref paths outside the snapshot fail explicitly.
Source files and referenced documents are never modified; reference paths are checked without reading referenced documents.
source_validation_policy: Extraction validates structural identity and containment, not newer admission requirements. Legacy omitted fields and unconventional nested values remain authored metadata for separate diagnostics.

verification.lint: ruff format --check and ruff check --no-cache passed for the two owned Python files
verification.mutation_method: Process-local mutations of the imported knowledge.native_types.component module; each test was called with a fresh temporary fixture, each injected fault was caught, and originals were restored before the final green run.

manufacture a component from document stem

integration_boundary: Shared field flattening, graph publication, legacy component-hub provenance, and Aura migration are coordinator responsibilities; this report makes no deployed Neo4j claim.
